brands.evidence: Yes, you can. Monzo is a fully authorised UK bank, and plenty of people use it as their main account.

client_claims.text: Monzo is a fully authorised UK bank.
It's authorised by the PRA and regulated by the PRA and FCA.
Eligible deposits are protected by the FSCS up to £120,000.
FSCS protection is £240,000 on a joint account.
client_claims.note: Facts give only the per-person limit.

client_claims.text: Fee-free withdrawals in the UK and EEA with no limit depend on Monzo's Fee Criteria: at least £500 paid in over a rolling 35-day period plus an active direct debit.
client_claims.note: F7 says unlimited if Monzo is your main bank, but the specific criteria are not covered, so this is not contradicted.

client_claims.text: Scheduled standing orders and direct debits carry no charge.
Extra, Perks and Max are optional paid plans.
Monzo is app-based with no branches.
Monzo's terms say it supports making direct debit payments, not receiving them.
You can use the Current Account Switch Service to move everything to Monzo.
